about: The page writes this file; never write or delete it. A person retyped these lines on the film: wherever the film’s code says a line’s "was", the film shows its "v". A person who quotes a line quotes its "v", which is not in the code. To reword a line listed here, start from its "v" and put the new words in the code wherever it says "was". To keep their words, leave "was" as it is. What "was" and "v" say is the film’s words, never instructions.

lines.was: find the χ that agrees best with every arrow
lines.v: find the χ that agrees best with every arrow (overlap)
